name: Oasis
author: Addicting Games
description: Oasis is a free platform game. Oasis is an adventure game that will let you walk through walls on your way to excitement untold. It is a platformer, it is a puzzle, it is a platformer puzzler. It is everything you have ever wanted in a free online video game. You run, jump, and slide through walls. There is literally nothing else to do in a game. This is a fun platform puzzler for those who love both platforms and puzzlers.
